mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy and depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early expansion phases, strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) signals rising consumer spending and corporate hiring, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of early expansion periods, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS in this regime falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) for two consecutive months indicates economic contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO remains below 100 for two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% (annualized), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer spending (RSAFS) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates demand-pull inflation, leading to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises and CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.
